verdict.rationale: Productboard's REST API supports personal-access-token authentication, cursor-based pagination, and webhooks, all of which enable scripted/headless use in CI or automation pipelines (docs-43, docs-51, docs-5). However, there is no explicit documentation of CI/CD integration, SDKs, or example automation scripts targeting headless pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples, official SDK/CLI for automation, and documented rate-limit/queueing guidance for unattended batch jobs.
